title: Canonical affine generic and closed fibre rings over a DVR
statement: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a morphism of schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $U$ an affine open of $X$. Let $\pi\in R$ be a uniformizer and $\rho:R\to A=\Gamma(X,U)$ the induced ring map. Suppose the scheme-theoretic closed fibre [def-pc-fibre-product] is reduced. Then $A/\rho(\pi)A$ is reduced, and there is a ring isomorphism $\varepsilon:\Gamma(X_\eta,i^{-1}U)\xrightarrow{\sim}A[1/\rho(\pi)]$, where $\eta=(0)$ and $i:X_\eta\to X$ is the fibre inclusion, such that $\varepsilon(i^*a)=a/1$ for every $a\in A$. No flatness, connectedness, nonemptiness or finiteness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Apply affine_fibre_sections_tensor to the closed and generic points. Its proved pullback-pasting and affine section-ring pushout comparison identifies sections with A tensor_R kappa(p), and restriction of a with a tensor 1.

Use Ideal.ResidueField at the zero prime as a fraction ring of R. DVR associated_pow_irreducible shows each nonzero denominator divides a power of pi. IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd makes this residue field a localization away from pi. IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv gives an A-algebra equivalence A tensor_R kappa(0) with A[1/rho(pi)]. Compose with the affine fibre comparison. Its restriction equation and the algebra equivalence commutes equation prove the required compatibility.

Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField identifies R/m with kappa(m) as an R-algebra. Tensor this equivalence with A, and compose it with quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot. The closed fibre is reduced, so its sections on the preimage of U are reduced. Transport reducedness first to A tensor_R kappa(m) and then to A/(mA), using the injective ring equivalences. Finally irreducible_iff_uniformizer and Ideal.map_span identify mA with the principal ideal generated by rho(pi). This works for the empty affine open and for a unit or zero image of pi.

theorem generic_fibre_affine_ring_models {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [IsReduced (f.fiber (closedPoint R))] (U : X.affineOpens)
    (π : R) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    let ρ := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ U.1 le_top
    _root_.IsReduced (Γ(X, U.1) ⧸ Ideal.span {ρ π}) ∧
      ∃ ε : Γ(f.fiber (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R),
          (f.fiberι (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃+*
          Localization.Away (ρ π),
        ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1),
          ε ((f.fiberι (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)).app U.1 a) =
            algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away (ρ π)) a
